Using DegreeSteps

A useful plan starts with clear expectations.

DegreeSteps is an educational planning resource. Use it to organize your options and prepare better questions.

Planning information and school decisions

DegreeSteps provides researched information, proposed degree pathways, and community features. Your receiving institution determines admission, transfer acceptance, degree placement, institutional-credit requirements, graduation eligibility, and other academic awards. A proposed plan, calculated total, or community badge does not replace its official decisions.

Changing information

Programs, prices, recommendation windows, provider availability, and transfer policies can change. Coverage and review dates are shown where available. Verify current details and obtain written approvals before spending money or relying on a course to meet a degree requirement.

Careers and professional qualifications

Academic degree completion and qualification for a regulated profession are separate matters. Check the jurisdiction, approved program, training, examinations, placements, and licensing requirements relevant to your own goal.

Your account and records

Use accurate information and protect your account and private backups. Only upload records you have the right to use. Review a plan before replacing a device draft or changing saved information.

Community participation

Share experiences and evidence honestly. Do not impersonate a school, fabricate outcomes, post private records without permission, harass others, or misuse reporting and voting controls. Public contributions may be reviewed or removed through the community moderation process.

Examples and outcomes

Illustrations and personal stories explain possibilities. They do not guarantee equivalent savings, transfer awards, completion times, admission, employment, or professional eligibility for another person.
